data.narrative:
Hypersonix Launch Systems is a Series A-stage defense & security company that has raised $46M AUD to date. Valuation analysis is anchored to a peer universe of 10 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage companies comprising 8 private firms and 2 public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS). Key private peers include Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, Singularity, and NODA AI, providing reference points across the frontier defense-tech landscape.

Two triangulation methods apply. Stage-progression analysis applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement, yielding $92M. Peer-median valuation across the 10-company comp set is $1.0B, with a range spanning $125M to $3.0B. This dispersion reflects variability in maturity and market positioning within the cohort; the five sampled peers (Dream Security at $3.0B, Harmattan AI at $1.4B, Code Metal at $1.2B, and Castelion and Defense Unicorns each at $1.0B) all occupy Series B stage, suggesting later-stage premium relative to Hypersonix's current position.

The two-method triangulation produces a range of $78M to $1.1B, with a median of $546M. The spread reflects material uncertainty around the company's technology maturation, addressable market capture, and path to cash flow. Stage-progression implies the low end; peer-median implies the high end. A mid-range valuation of $200–400M appears most defensible absent revenue traction or material technical milestones.
